instruction.name: xvmini.wu
instruction.description: Compute elementwise minimum for unsigned 32-bit elements in `a` and the zero-extended `imm`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvmini.wu $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvmini.wu $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvmini.wu $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvmini.wu $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvmini.wu $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvmini.wu $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvmini.wu $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvmini.wu $xr7, $xr15, 1
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvmini.wu $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvmini.wu $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvmini.wu $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvmini.wu $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvmini.wu $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvmini.wu $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvmini.wu $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvmini.wu $xr7, $xr15, 1'
